name: Call Graph
description: Calls another graph from the shared library by its process id, the way session-skeleton.bpmn's craft callActivity calls craft_graph. `linkGraph` resolves and inlines the target into the session at start, so it must be a plain string naming a process id, not a dynamic FEEL expression.

properties.label: Graph to call
properties.description: The process id of a graph in the shared library (its bpmn:process id, not the file name).
